Jamie: Pushed a short PRD draft for launch gating around cryptographic audit logs and retention. link: https://redwood.docs/prd/crypto-audit-draft — please scan acceptance criteria.
Ravi: Thanks — reading now. Core ask from security: tamper-evident audit stream, customer-controlled KMS support, and auditable export for 3rd-party forensics.
Sofia: Quick Q: do we need HSM-backed signing for every event, or is envelope signing at ingestion ok? Tradeoff for latency.
Ravi: HSM for signing of master keys; per-event signing can be KMS-signed tokens (envelope). Acceptance criteria should call out PKI proof-of-possession for signing keys.
Lee: We should call out retention SLOs and export tooling. infra impact: storing raw audit events 7yrs is big. propose: default 1yr hot, cold-tier up to 7yrs with export-on-request.
Jamie: Customers asking for 7 yrs (regulated fintech). Product proposal: default retention 1yr, add paid retention packs + one-click export for compliance requests. Add an acceptance criterion for export format (JSONL + integrity sig).
Ravi: Acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) Logs immutable for configured retention window, 2) Export contains integrity signature and manifest, 3) KMS-backed key rotations tracked and versioned, 4) Evidence for SOC2: retention policy + access audit for exports.
Sofia: Edge-case: cross-region DR — if a region fails, can we still attest log continuity? Need a fallback chain-of-trust and an expected RTO. Add: must demonstrate end-to-end continuity during region failover in test plan.
Lee: Ops note: will add a canary that replays signed events to the compliance bucket. Need a small schema change to include signing metadata: {"sig_version","key_id","prev_hash"}.
Jamie: I'll add schema snippet to PRD. Also adding rollout gate: security sign-off + one customer pilot (non-prod) with export exercise. Target: next quarter beta.
Ravi: One more: document key-recovery process for customers (KMS import/export) and HSM certification level required for enterprise.
Sofia: Implementation tasks: a) signing service + KMS integration, b) retention controls + lifecycle policies, c) export job + tamper verification tool. Est dev: 6-8 wks for MVP.
Jamie: Action items: Jamie -> update PRD with criteria and schema by EOD Thu; Ravi -> draft SOC2 evidence checklist by Mon; Lee -> feasibility note for cold-tier storage and cost estimates by Fri; Sofia -> proto for signing service plan by next Tue.
security-bot: Reminder: add "compliance:security-review" label to PRD doc.
